description: This file declares the interface for the OcdmSystem class and its factory, which are responsible for managing OpenCDM system operations such as retrieving version info, session limits, and hashes, as well as creating sessions. It includes external dependencies related to OpenCDM and defines the classes within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace.

classes.name: OcdmSystemFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of OcdmSystem, implementing the IOcdmSystemFactory interface.

classes.name: OcdmSystem
classes.description: Implementation of the IOcdmSystem interface, managing OpenCDM system operations such as version retrieval, session management, and storage handling.

methods.name: createOcdmSystem
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IOcdmSystem instance for the specified key system.

methods.name: OcdmSystem
methods.description: Constructor initializing the OcdmSystem with a specific key system string.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of the DRM system.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the limit for LDL (License Delivery Limit) sessions.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getSecureStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the secure store.

methods.name: getDrmTime
methods.description: Gets the current DRM system time.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with the specified client.
